newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Mezogep Q1 net profit falls on FX losses.
newsitem.headline: Mezogep Q1 net profit falls on FX losses.

text.p: Hungarian machinery company Mezogep Rt said on Wednesday that it almost doubled its operating profits in the first quarter of the year but its net profit fell due to exchange rate losses.

The company boosted its operating profits by 133 million forints to 263 million forints in the first three months of the year, but its net profit fell to 58 million forints from 88 million forints in January-March 1996.
Mezogep registered one-off exchange rate losses of 192 million forints, compared with an exchange rate loss of 29 million forints in the first quarter of 1996.
Quarterly sales rose to 1.254 billion forints, up from 795 million in the same period of last year, the company said, adding that this year it had orders worth 756 million forints.
At 0948 GMT Mezogep shares traded at 2,415 forints, up 115, on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
